register_lora_adapter: register a new LoRA adapter with a name, path, and pinned status in the registry
unregister_lora_adapter: unregister a LoRA adapter by name and retrieve its unique LoRA ID
acquire_lora_adapter: acquire a LoRA adapter by name and start tracking its usage counter
release_lora_adapter: release a LoRA adapter by ID and decrement its usage counter
wait_for_unload_lora: wait until a LoRA adapter's usage counter reaches zero before unloading
